verifications.claim: Costs vary based on the extent of the damage and insurance coverage.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R4: 'costs vary based on the severity... extent of damage'; 'Insurance Coverage... you’ll always need to pay a deductible'; R8: 'costs vary widely based on the fire’s severity and affected areas'; R1: 'depends on the severity of fire'
verifications.reasoning: Extent of damage clearly varies costs; insurance affects out-of-pocket but not restoration cost itself, so broader/less precise.
